firstContext: 💛 You hold Dog tags. Not yours. Francesca's. You carry them so someone is remembered — the promise you made in the dust. Francesca would laugh at you carrying them into the apocalypse. Your gifts are not mastered — but they are lived-in, and they are with you. The feast was the weapon.

w5Mentions.firstLine: ◈ ABILITY — War-table: You read the table's fear the way you read weather. The Nielsen flinches first — you saw it.
firstContext: 📺 SYSTEM: "EVERYONE. SIT. WATCH. The teeth and the weather can WAIT — nothing out there matters until this is done. ...Did I stutter? SIT."

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: Night settles. The fire is the whole world now. No watches posted. The dark feels bigger than it should.
Sofia left 2 bark strips by the stash. No announcement. That's how it works here.

w5Mentions.name: The Commercial Break
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 Scouts found the broadcast tower — tile 7,2. THE FINALE does not arrive alone: first, its crew. THE COMMERCIAL BREAK (node 1 of 3). Kill the production staff and the finale airs without a safety net — no one left to call "cut." The march needs 20 allied blades. Sound the call.
firstContext: 📓 Codex: Ivy taught Marcus Mediation.

🌙 Watchers at the southeast treeline see torchlight moving in Thornfield's camp — and it going dark. Whatever was coming, the doubled watch turned it. The night stays quiet, and everyone at the fire understands why.

🌪️ THE FINALE fed in the night — 260 kcal gone from your stores. It is eating the realm while you deliberate.
— DAY 79 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (20/10/6), with 2 wave-4 and 3 wave-5 fought, 10 contests survived, 4 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 5 · Forage 7 · Craft 3 · Talk 16 · Explore 36 → 24 · capped)
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. The protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE ARCHITECT — Ivy Wang ascended through doors you built: relay. The galaxy will remember the god's name. The village will remember who built the door. Both are true. Neither is small.

gotAwayLines: It got away. No meat, no trophy — but you're breathing, and now you know its moves.
